messages:
Alex Cheng: Quick sync — SI onboarding pilot for Q3: proposed timeline and flow attached (see link). Need alignment on marketplace listing, HW voucher limits, and sandbox SLA. Any immediate blockers?
Maya Patel: Looks good at a glance. Main risk = time to provision sandbox for partner cohorts. Need automation.
Chris O'Neil: +1. I'll own a provisioning checklist: VPN, KMS access, GPU quota request, identity mapping. Will drop a draft here.
Jen Park: Also want a short cert (30 min) + a one-page playbook for partner sales to reduce friction.
Alex Cheng: Chris + Jen — can you pair and have draft items by next Wed? I'll reach out to hardware partner for voucher codes and to marketplace team for listing requirements.
Sam Ortiz: FYI I spun up a small sandbox in us-west (4x T4s) for early testing. Credentials stored in 1Password under "SI-Pilot/Sandbox". Not production grade but good for dry runs.
Maya Patel: Can we make signup -> sandbox -> onboarding course -> cert an automated funnel? If the marketplace registration can trigger a webhook we can orchestrate.
Alex Cheng: Proposed funnel: 1) Marketplace registration 2) SI intake form (contact + use-case) 3) Sandbox provisioning (auto for approved) 4) Self-study lab + 1 live workshop 5) Cert exam + perf check 6) Badge issuance + partner listing. Thoughts?
Chris O'Neil: For cert/perf check proposal: deploy sample app to Dedicated or Dedicated-sim, run a smoke perf test (p50 < 300ms for 512-token generator on benchmark), and complete lab exercises. We should tier thresholds by instance class.
Jen Park: Agree on tiered pass thresholds. Also add a compliance checklist: no-PHI data in labs, KMS usage required for private deployments, and basic audit logging must be enabled.
Alex Cheng: Good call — will add compliance gating to the playbook. Who can draft the marketplace announcement and partner-facing comms? @Maya Patel
Maya Patel: I can take comms. Will need final dates, a partner quote, and a short TL;DR blurb. Prefer to publish after first cohort completes certs.
Jen Park: I'll ping Nebula Systems (HW partner) for a short quote and vouchers. Asking product ops for voucher limits.
oncall-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance scheduled Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC — sandbox provisioning and tests may be affected.
Alex Cheng: Noted — we'll avoid scheduling live workshops during that window. Thanks all :thumbsup:
